articles.summary: Revolve Group, Inc. (NYSE: RVLV), the next-generation fashion retailer for Millennial and Generation Z consumers, today announced financial results for the third quarter ended September 30, 2026. "We delivered a strong third quarter, highlighted by net sales growth of 20% or more across our segments, REVOLVE and FWRD, and in domestic and international markets," said co-founder and co-CEO Mike Karanikolas. "Supporting our top-line momentum was 18% growth in active customers year-over-year, our fourth consecutive quarter of growth acceleration." "Our strong top line growth and customer engagement metrics are a reflection of our brand strength and a result of our investments in brand building, physical retail expansion and key partnerships, including the recent launch of REVOLVE Los Angeles and our inaugural REVOLVE Magazine, our new joint venture with Donatella Versace, and recently-announced expanded partnerships with Kendall Jenner and Dwyane Wade," said co-founder and co-CEO Michael
